title: Batching and nondeterministic LLM inference
one_liner: Thinking Machines' September 2025 post links temperature-zero output variation to load-dependent batch sizes and proposes batch-invariant kernels.
caution: Older research; temperature zero alone isn't a guarantee.
quote: the primary reason nearly all LLM inference endpoints are nondeterministic is that the load (and thus batch-size) nondeterministically varies!
discrepancies: The page shows 'Sep 10, 2025'. No captured page records the October 7 debate (provider only).

title: Cortex Harness: remote human guidance for robots
one_liner: Cortex Robot announced Cortex Harness: operators steer robot models by prompt or VR takeover, and interventions become recovery data.
caution: Curated demos and waitlist; no intervention rates or post-retraining autonomy gains shown.
quote: We’re excited to announce Cortex Harness, a platform for running AI models on real robots with remote human guidance.
discrepancies: Access is through a beta waitlist, not general availability.
